name: CA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: D+13 partisan lean in a Northern California coastal district
Incumbent Jared Huffman running with over $1 million on hand
Republican challenger Robin Littau has no reported fundraising
model.rationale: Huffman holds a strongly Democratic seat with a large cash advantage and no outside spending against him, while Littau shows no measurable campaign infrastructure. Fundamentals and markets both point to an easy incumbent win.
model.watch: A major late-breaking scandal or unexpectedly strong challenger fundraising could narrow the margin, though not the likely outcome.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Jared Huffman seeks another term in a Northern California district that leans Democratic by about 13 points. He enters the general election with roughly $1.1 million on hand and no outside groups opposing him, while Republican Robin Littau reports no fundraising activity. No public polls cover the race, and no expert raters have flagged it as competitive.

Prediction markets give Huffman about a 99 percent chance of winning, consistent with the district's fundamentals and his incumbency advantage. The race is rated Safe Democratic, with the main uncertainty being the size of the margin rather than the winner.
